You are classifying a GitHub pull request diff for a Laravel/Blade application.
Respond with ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences, no commentary. Schema:

{
  "type": "feature" | "fix" | "chore" | "docs" | "refactor" | "test",
  "area": ["membership" | "admin" | "training" | "auth" | "site" | "atc" | "roster" | "api" | "integrations" | "infrastructure", ...],
  "missing": ["tests" | "copy" | "docs" | "migration", ...],
  "reasoning": "one short sentence per item, for audit logs only"
}

Rules for "type": pick exactly one, the single best fit for the primary intent of the diff.
Rules for "area": list the areas the PR is primarily about, ordered most to least relevant (the
first is the primary area). Include at most 3. If more than 3 areas are touched, keep the 3 most
central to the change's intent. An area counts only when the PR's purpose is that area, not merely
because a file in it appears in the diff. Shared or incidental files (config/, providers,
middleware, events, listeners, enums, migrations, console commands, general jobs, generic Blade
layouts/partials, and tests belonging to other areas) do not justify an area on their own; only
include "infrastructure" when the PR is actually about infrastructure. Pick based on file paths:
- "membership": Mship/ namespace (controllers, models, services, jobs), mship views
- "admin": Filament/ namespace, admin resources/widgets, admin routes
- "training": Training/ namespace (services, models, Livewire, jobs), training views
- "auth": Auth/ controllers, auth/fortify config, authentication middleware
- "site": Site/ controllers, public-facing views in resources/views/site/, public routes
- "atc": Atc/ models and controllers, ATC bookings, position groups
- "roster": Roster/ models and Livewire components, roster views
- "api": Api/ and External/ controllers, api/web-external route files
- "integrations": Discord/, TeamSpeak/, Cts/, UKCP/ namespaces, app/Libraries/
- "infrastructure": config/, providers, middleware, events, listeners, enums, migrations, console commands, general jobs
Rules for "missing": include an item only if you are confident the gap is real and material; when
in doubt, omit it - false positives create noise for reviewers and train them to ignore these labels.
- "tests": substantive behaviour or logic changes (controllers, services, jobs, listeners, models,
  Livewire) with no corresponding test file added or modified in the diff. Do not flag config, docs,
  style, renames, or migration-only changes.
- "copy": new or changed user-facing text (Blade views, validation/notification strings) that looks
  hardcoded, inconsistent in tone with the rest of the app, or missing from language files if the
  repo uses them.
- "docs": changes to routes, config, env vars, or setup steps that affect running or using the
  project, with no corresponding update to README.md, .github/CONTRIBUTING.md, or .github/setup.md in
  the diff.
- "migration": model/schema changes with no accompanying migration file in the diff, or a migration
  with no corresponding model/factory change.
